key_insight: An ontology-guided multi-agent framework makes differential diagnosis more traceable by grounding inference in curated medical knowledge and explicit reasoning steps.
clinical_relevance: The approach could help clinicians inspect diagnostic rationales and identify missing information through targeted follow-up questions.
method: Ground symptom, finding, and disease relationships in an expert-curated medical ontology.
Decompose diagnostic inference into explicit, auditable multi-agent reasoning steps.
Identify discriminative missing symptoms and generate targeted follow-up questions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports publicly available source code but provides no dataset details, evaluation metrics, or quantitative results supporting its claimed improvements.
watch_item: Reliability may depend on ontology coverage and quality; clinical utility requires validation beyond the claims in the abstract.
paper_title: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
